overview_description.description: Epic Games is an American video game and software company that creates games and offers its game engine technology to other developers. It specializes in developing games and engine technology and operates a game store that empowers others to make quality games and 3D content, thereby providing game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and virtual reality devices.

press_references.value: Ariana Grande and Travis Scott Fortnite concerts at the heart of patent lawsuit headed to trial

The case, which began in 2021, is set to go to a jury trial on May 12, 2025, focusing on a patent describing technology for replaying experiences in virtual worlds.

product.name: Fortnite
product.description: An online multiplayer game combining battle royale, user-created experiences, social features, and creator tools across supported platforms.

product.name: Unreal Engine
product.description: A real-time 3D development engine used to create games, simulations, visualizations, and interactive applications.

product.name: Epic Games Store
product.description: A digital storefront and distribution platform for purchasing, downloading, and managing PC games and related content.

product.name: Epic Online Services
product.description: A set of online services and software development tools for adding multiplayer, accounts, cross-platform features, and related infrastructure to games.

product.name: Fab
product.description: A digital marketplace for discovering, purchasing, and distributing 3D assets, environments, plugins, and other content for interactive projects.

product.name: MetaHuman
product.description: A framework and collection of tools for creating and animating realistic digital humans for games, film, and other real-time applications.
